question.problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $P,$ given by

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 & 7 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -6 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

current_example.problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $A,$ given by
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14118900/assets/b7bd0927ad34eb75ec2d6e7d03509b983e8a90e8846c42b2da6e6898cb50afa3.svg)
current_example.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $A$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & -6 & 1 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+2{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $A$ has $3$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $3.$
